item.title: TCRSD Wraps Up Big Year
item.description: In 2025, Turkey Regional Sewer District’s board crossed several items off its to-do list - one of which had been there for two decades.

item.title: Indiana Seeks To Lift 20-Year Ban On Historical Monument At Statehouse
item.description: Attorney General Todd Rokita and Gov. Mike Braun recently filed a motion in federal court asking to remove a more than 20-year-old injunction that blocks the placement of a donated historical monument on the Indiana Statehouse grounds.

item.title: Rochester Man Arrested for Allegedly Molesting Children
item.description: A Rochester man was arrested for allegedly molesting several children.

item.title: Warsaw senior named Player of the Week
item.description: Warsaw senior Brooke Zartman was recognized by the Indiana Basketball Coaches Association as a Player of the Week.

item.title: Harlan Hite Is A Superfan
item.description: Whether it is high school sports, music or theater, Harlan Hite finds enjoyment in all of it.

item.title: Consumers Expected To Return Nearly $850B In Merchandise This Season
item.description: Retailers estimate that 15.8% of their annual sales will be returned this holiday season, totaling $849.9 billion, according to the 2025 Retail Returns Landscape report released by the National Retail Federation and Happy Returns, a UPS company.

item.title: Light Up Rochester winners announced
item.description: Winners of the Light Up Rochester were announced Friday, Dec. 19, with monetary prize money presented to the six winners.

item.title: Milford Fire Department Presents Awards
item.description: Members of the Milford Fire Department were presented with awards during the department's end-of-the-year party held Thursday, Dec. 18.

item.title: Metzger Auction to Host Final Penguin Point Headquarters Auction
item.description: Metzger Auction will host the final online auction at the former iconic Penguin Point headquarters located at 2691 E US 30, Warsaw, Indiana, offering the public one last opportunity to own a piece of the legendary Indiana restaurant brand.

item.title: Rural Health Funding Offers Billions To States, With Conditions Attached
item.description: The Trump administration is rolling out a new rural health care funding program that will distribute billions of dollars to states in 2026, while reserving the ability to reduce or withdraw that funding if states fail to adopt policy priorities favored by the White House.
